originality.rationale: The full paper comparison identifies and explicitly credits the known maximum mu(K_n square P_3)=2n by Theorem 3.4 of arXiv:2112.13024. The new proposition gives the exact two-family enumeration, the maximality classification and the lower number n+1, none implied by that scalar maximum or the 4-cycle characterization restricted to two complete factors. The 2023 lower-number and 2024 visibility-polynomial works and 2026 Builder-Blocker work inspected do not state or cover the full hybrid factor enumerators. Targeted mathematical literature and indexed-result comparisons found no equivalent; unresolved unindexed coverage is documented.
residual_risks: A differently named or unindexed result may classify the same clique-by-three-path product and imply the new enumerators.
Generic visibility-polynomial identities may admit a hidden specialization; no exhaustive database search establishes priority.

value.rationale: Exact classification and complete counts of ALL feasible and ALL inclusion-maximal selected-pair visibility sets on the natural clique-layer path K_n square P_3. Determines exact worst greedy termination n+1 and maximality-count 2n*3^(n-1)+2^n-1 despite already-known largest cardinality 2n. The lower-versus-upper gap n-1 and complete maximal size spectrum are motivated, nontrivial consequences of the structural theorem, not a scalar recomputation.
